BrochureContent.Content:
Presented in excellent condition throughout, No. 3 Cherrywood Heights is a spacious and beautifully maintained five-bedroom family home ideally positioned in a mature and sought-after residential development in the thriving town of Midleton.

Extending to generous family proportions, this impressive home offers superbly balanced accommodation with bright and welcoming interiors designed for modern family living. A particular feature of the property is the versatile ground floor bedroom, ideal for guests, remote working, or multi-generational living.

Accommodation comprises an inviting entrance hallway, a spacious living room complete with feature fireplace, a bright and airy fitted kitchen with island unit, dining area with direct access to the rear garden, utility room, and downstairs WC. Upstairs there are four further well-proportioned bedrooms including a spacious main bedroom with ensuite, together with a main family bathroom and additional shower room, bringing the total to three bathrooms.

The property is presented in very good decorative order throughout and benefits from excellent natural light and generous living accommodation.

Externally, the home enjoys parking to the front together with a private rear garden featuring a garden shed and ample space for outdoor dining, entertaining or family use.

Cherrywood Heights is ideally located within easy reach of all local amenities including schools, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, sports clubs, and leisure facilities. Midleton is renowned for its vibrant community atmosphere, excellent shopping facilities, and famous farmers market, while nearby attractions include the Midleton Distillery Experience and numerous East Cork beaches and coastal walks. 

The property also benefits from excellent transport connectivity. Cork City is approximately a 25-minute drive away, while regular commuter rail services from Midleton Train Station connect directly to Kent Station in Cork City in approximately 20 minutes. Bus services and excellent road links also make commuting particularly convenient. 

This is an ideal opportunity to acquire a substantial turnkey family home in one of East Cork’s most popular residential locations.
